annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account (default: {})

automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials (default: true)

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created (default: true)

cephCommandsTimeoutSeconds.description: The timeout for ceph commands in seconds

containerSecurityContext.description: Set the container security context for the operator

installCsiOperator.description: When true, install the ceph-csi-operator subchart (see Chart.yaml `condition`).

interval.description: Interval at which metrics should be scraped

namespace.description: Namespace in which to deploy the ServiceMonitor

currentNamespaceOnly.description: Whether the operator should watch cluster CRD in its own namespace or not

customHostnameLabel.description: Custom label to identify node hostname. If not set `kubernetes.io/hostname` will be used

deleteUnusedCrushRules.description: If true, delete unused generated CRUSH rules after the mgr starts

disableDeviceHotplug.description: Disable automatic orchestration when new devices are discovered.

discoverDaemonUdev.description: Blacklist certain disks according to the regex provided.

discoveryDaemonInterval.description: Set the discovery daemon device discovery interval (default to 60m)

enableOBCWatchOperatorNamespace.description: Whether the OBC provisioner should watch on the operator namespace or not, if not the namespace of the cluster will be used

enforceHostNetwork.description: Whether to create all Rook pods to run on the host network, for example in environments where a CNI is not enabled

hostpathRequiresPrivileged.description: Runs Ceph Pods as privileged to be able to write to `hostPaths` in OpenShift with SELinux restrictions.

imagePullSecrets.description:
imagePullSecrets option allow to pull docker images from private docker registry. Option will be passed to all service accounts.
- name: my-registry-secret

logLevel.description:
Global log level for the operator.
Options: `ERROR`, `WARNING`, `INFO`, `DEBUG`

monRunAsRoot.description: If true, ceph mon pods will be run as root

enabled.description:
Enable monitoring. Requires Prometheus to be pre-installed.
Enabling will also create RBAC rules to allow Operator to create ServiceMonitors

nodeSelector.description:
Kubernetes [`nodeSelector`](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/#nodeselector) to add to the Deployment.
Constraint rook-ceph-operator Deployment to nodes with label `disktype: ssd`.
For more info, see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/#nodeselector
disktype: ssd

obcAllowAdditionalConfigFields.description:
Many OBC additional config fields may be risky for administrators to allow users control over.
The safe and default-allowed fields are 'maxObjects' and 'maxSize'.
Other fields should be considered risky. To allow all additional configs, use this value:
"maxObjects,maxSize,bucketMaxObjects,bucketMaxSize,bucketPolicy,bucketLifecycle,bucketOwner"

obcProvisionerNamePrefix.description: Specify the prefix for the OBC provisioner in place of the cluster namespace

operatorPodLabels.description: Custom pod labels for the operator

priorityClassName.description: Set the priority class for the rook operator deployment if desired

rbacEnable.description: If true, create & use RBAC resources

reconcileConcurrentClusters.description: Number of clusters the operator reconciles concurrently

revisionHistoryLimit.description: The revision history limit for all pods created by Rook. If blank, the K8s default is 10.

scaleDownOperator.description:
If true, scale down the rook operator.
This is useful for administrative actions where the rook operator must be scaled down, while using gitops style tooling
to deploy your helm charts.

tolerations.description: List of Kubernetes [`tolerations`](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/) to add to the Deployment.

unreachableNodeTolerationSeconds.description:
Delay to use for the `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable` pod failure toleration to override
the Kubernetes default of 5 minutes

useOperatorHostNetwork.description: If true, run rook operator on the host network
